articles.title: Russia Gets a Green Light — But No Flag Yet — for the 2028 Olympics!
articles.summary: The IOC just lifted its ban on Russia’s Olympic committee, so Russian athletes can start competing again. But they still can’t wave their flag or play their anthem at the LA 2028 Games. IOC President Kirsty Coventry says athletes shouldn’t be punished for their government’s actions.

articles.title: Why Are Roads Buckling in the Heat? And Can We Fix It Before LA 2028?
articles.summary: A heat wave over July 4th weekend made roads buckle in Baltimore and Chicago. Scientists say climate change is bringing more extreme heat and rain, which weakens pavement. Engineers can build stronger roads, but it costs more — so we have to decide how much we’re willing to pay.

articles.title: 169 Years Later, a Famous Court Case About Freedom Still Echoes Today
articles.summary: Descendants of Dred Scott and the judge who ruled against him met in Washington, D.C. They talked about the 1857 Supreme Court case that said enslaved people weren’t citizens. Recently, the court ruled that almost all babies born in the U.S. are citizens, but three justices disagreed — showing old debates aren’t over.
